name: pi-ui
description: A local web UI for the pi coding agent, embedding the pi SDK in-process: streamed transcripts, chat-history browsing, and a full inspector for every LLM and tool call.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check test/smoke.js && node --check sdk/load.js && node --check sdk/host.js && node --check sdk/events.js && node --check sdk/images.js && node --check sdk/ui-context.js && node --check sdk/wire.js

// devDependencies: Only used by `npm run typecheck` (see jsconfig.json). They are not needed to run or test pi-ui, which stays dependency-free: `node server.js` and `npm test` work on a bare checkout.
